agentRuns.title: Agent Runs
agentRuns.subtitle: Live supervision of agent runs — stuck runs are detected and cancellable.
agentRuns.verification.passedTitle: A reviewer model checked this run's output against its goal and found the goal achieved.
agentRuns.verification.failedTitle: A reviewer model found the goal was not achieved. The gaps were handed back to the agent once.
agentRuns.verification.unverifiedTitle: The run could not be checked (no reviewer model available, or nothing recorded to check).
agentRuns.action.resumeTitle: Continue from the last checkpoint (do-not-repeat guard)
agentRuns.action.retryTitle: Re-plan the task from the goal — already-executed destructive calls are still guarded (do-not-repeat)
